notes.title: S.O.R.S patch v1.01 live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’ve pushed a quick update to improve a couple of gameplay aspects based on player feedback:

1. Lifestyle advice: I’ve removed some of the more ambiguous items so this first stage should be fairer and less based on guesswork

2. Osteoporosis/Diabetes graph marks: added text describing what you need to look for on the graph itself. Hopefully this should make it easier to work out what patterns you need to look for.

That’s it for now. Thanks a lot for your support and keep that feedback coming. 


Rich

notes.title: S.O.R.S post-launch update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'd just like to thank everyone for their reception of S.O.R.S so far, it's been phenomenal! Loads of positive youtube videos, comments, reviews, have really made me feel happy! And it really feels like the last year and a half was worth it :)

My intention is to be as active as possible with the players, so if you've bought the game feel free to head over to the forums to discuss it. I'm going to pushing updates to the game based on feedback, so that's your chance to influence what gets updated. 

I'll post further announcements as we go along. For now, have fun, move that scanner carefully and hit those government targets! ;)

thanks
Rich

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - S.O.R.S
notes.notes:
S.O.R.S is Now Available on Steam!

You are a new recruit at a high tech medical facility where doctors are being fired and patients are dying. Find out what’s going on, but make sure you hit the government targets otherwise you’ll be fired.



Easier said than done, when that mysterious hacker is disrupting your equipment .
